data.Title: Zero Woman
data.Writer: Daisuke Gotô, Chiaki Hashiba, Tooru Shinohara

data.Plot: A gang of young thieves try to rob a mob boss, but their heist is interrupted by an officer of the Tokyo Police Department's elite Zero Division. They get away with the loot, but the officer, a beautiful, more-than-slightly psycho...
